name: ECE 3163
title: Robot Control and Dynamics
description: (Also offered as ME 3163.) Basic concepts of robot manipulator modeling and control including joint space and task space control, Euler-Lagrange dynamics, independent joint control, whole robot manipulator control, robot control using visual feedback, robot control with trajectory planner. The course will include robot controller implementation via a course project and practical examples throughout the course.
requirement_description: ECE/ME 3161; ECE 3111 or ME 3253 or ME 3254; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
